name: brief-desk
description: One-repo CopilotKit desk with Python MCP backend and bundled corpus

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui,mcp -c blue,green "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:mcp"
scripts.mcp:py: cd backend && uv run python -m brief_desk_mcp
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test mcp/src/server.test.ts mcp/src/plan.test.ts mcp/src/corpus.test.ts lib/prompts.test.ts lib/fallback-ui.test.ts lib/format-brief.test.ts lib/brief-run.test.ts lib/brief-run.abort.test.ts lib/brief-run-repos.test.ts lib/brief-history.test.ts lib/plan-board.test.ts lib/select-options.test.ts lib/repo-suggest.test.ts lib/github-trending.test.ts lib/session-link.test.ts lib/sync-merge.test.ts lib/abort.test.ts lib/mcp-client.abort.test.ts lib/mcp-client.contract.test.ts lib/brief-run-api.contract.test.ts lib/citations.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:mcp:py && npm run test:unit
